name: OmniVoz
author: OmniVoz contributors
description: Local voice agent status: shows whether OmniVoz is listening, thinking or acting, lets you toggle it, and shows the active configuration.

barWidget.description: Voice agent state, toggle and live configuration

schema.label: Refresh interval (ms)
schema.description: How often the widget re-reads the OmniVoz status file.

schema.label: Toggle command
schema.description: Run with a right or middle click to start/stop listening.

schema.label: Config file
schema.description: Path shown in the panel (the file read by OmniVoz at startup).
